allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: major refactoring - extract utilities to individual files

Extract all applets from monolithic mod.rs files into separate files:
- Archive: bzip2, compress, cpio, gzip, tar, unzip, xz
- Misc: base64, cmp, diff, expr, factor, getconf, hash, hexdump, etc.
- Network: arp, arping, brctl, ftpget, host, ifconfig, ip, nc, ping, etc.
- Process: chrt, ionice, kill, killall, nice, nohup, pgrep, pidof, ps, top
- Shell: arithmetic, builtins, control, execute, expand, parser, state
- System: acpi, blkid, df, dmesg, du, halt, i2c*, insmod, login, mount, etc.

Key improvements:
- Implement full SHA-512/SHA-256 crypt for login.rs \(no external deps\)
- Enhance vi editor with command/insert modes, line operations
- Implement patch utility with context/unified diff support
- Add chattr/lsattr for ext2/3/4 file attributes
- Implement file utility with magic number detection
- Add IO layer utilities \(urandom, pid/uid/gid getters\)

This refactoring improves code organization and maintainability while
keeping all utilities POSIX compliant with minimal unsafe Rust usage.
EOF
\)")
